        ZERO-SERVER PRIVACY
        
Your prompt stays yours.

        
The scanner runs entirely in your browser using transparent pattern-matching rules. There is no account, analytics payload, prompt database, or external AI request.

        
    
          
  • ✓Works without an AI API
    • 
          
  • ✓No prompt history or tracking
    • 
          
  • ✓Readable, auditable open-source code
    • 
        

      

      

        
privacy-engine.js

        
// Your text stays on this device
const result = scanLocally(prompt);

result.uploaded  // false
result.tracked   // false
result.protected // true
